description: Devon Energy Corporation is a leading independent energy company engaged primarily in the exploration, development and production of oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids, with its operations concentrated in various onshore areas in the U.S. It is also focused on water stewardship in support of its environmental objectives, continuing to advance its use of recycled water and targeting the use of 90 percent or more non-freshwater for completions activities in its most active operating areas within the Delaware Basin.
